label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI, plus Uvation Pulse and Atlas CRM
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 22 items closed on 1 Oct: the RMA backend (MT-1488) and its five email-trigger subtasks, the customer account area story (MT-1311) with six of its subtasks, the text-overflow bug (MT-1533) and three B300/GB300 attribute corrections (PC-138 to PC-140). Ten new RMA item-level decision subtasks were raised. The catalogue re-check (PC-136), due 30 Sep, is still in progress. Past due fell from 17 to 9; 4 bugs are open, none rated.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: 57 items moved to Ready for Prod on 1 Oct, among them 29 Figma fixes (27 of 56 now done), the sitemap fix (MR-1199, MR-1200) and the GDPR design fix (MR-1253, blocked the day before). 9 items closed. The board workflow was renamed the same day, and five June tasks (MR-735 to MR-740) were moved into a new 'In Prod1' status that Jira does not count as done, so they now show as past due with MR-1168. 11 bugs are open, none rated.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: 102 open items were due on 30 Sep, the sprint end, and missed it: 68 are still in To Do, 17 are deployed to production but not closed, and 10 are in progress. Past due is now 108, up from 8. The three S1 production bugs (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502) are still in To Do. 11 items closed on 1 Oct, mostly S3 UI bugs. 53 bugs are open, 5 of them S1.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The CSM Teams dashboard (UC-215) and the logged-in marketplace user story (UC-216) closed on 1 Oct with all eight subtasks, one day after UC-215's due date. A new story for marketplace sign-in to the AI chatbot (UC-225, 4 subtasks) was raised. All 56 open items are in To Do; four, including UC-225, are due 15 Oct, and nothing is past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: No changes on 1 Oct. One item is done (PULSE-329). The other 328 (8 epics, 64 stories, 256 subtasks) are all held by Anshul Bhargava, 246 In Progress and 82 To Do, and none has a due date. Tempo shows 2.5 h in total, on 29 and 30 Sep.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: No changes on 1 Oct. One story, ATLAS-1 'R&D on CRM for MVP', created 28 Sep and held by Anshul Bhargava, is still in To Do with no due date. 2.75 h is logged against it (2 h on 28 Sep, 45 min on 29 Sep).
